digest.component_or_area: gate-dispatch error handling and sidecar recording
propositions: Infra exceptions (LLMUnavailableError) at plan-review and code-review gates must emit an ERROR sidecar record while preserving the existing degraded INDETERMINATE verdict outcome.
Infra exceptions at the completion gate must emit an ERROR sidecar record and then re-raise the exception, preserving the fail-closed contract.
A new dedicated schema tag gate_error_v1 must be introduced to record infra errors additively without routing through reconcile_verdict, so ERROR verdicts are not coerced to FAIL.
Domain-level BLOCK/FAIL outcomes must not emit ERROR records; only infrastructure exceptions are captured.
Existing verdict readers (latest_review_result, latest_fail_verdict) must remain schema-guarded to skip gate_error_v1 records and never expose ERROR verdicts to callers.
